answer: Split-tally bond: each identity locks 70 credits and splits one tally in two, keeping one half, the other filed in a garden ledger by keepers. A comet audit draws 5% of identities per epoch to show their half; rented halves fail. A mismatch burns the bond, sending a ripple through the cluster. Filing is 40, plus 6 per extra identity from one funder, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 once and reclaim the bond.
